resources.string: Shows the day and date as a normal notification icon in the status bar. Text size adapts to the device status-bar space and works without root, Xposed, Accessibility, or Shizuku.
Allow Statusbarplus to bypass battery optimization so the notification and midnight update are less likely to be delayed by the system.
Active • using an Android status-bar notification.
Text size adapts to the device status-bar area so it stays readable without clipping. This mode uses a normal Android notification.

1. Turn on “Show day”.

2. Choose the status-bar content: day, day + date, day + date + month, or date + month.

3. Adjust the text size. It adapts to the device status-bar space so it remains readable without clipping.

4. Choose the system font or import your own TTF/OTF font.

5. If your device often stops background apps, allow the battery-optimization exemption. This is optional.
Use the system font or import one TTF/OTF font of your choice.
The selected file is not a valid TTF/OTF font.
